features.name: Pick videos from Photos
features.description: Multi-select videos from the photo library; thumbnails show each file size.

features.name: Frame rate slider
features.description: Slider for output frame rate, with a hint not to go under 24 fps.
features.reason: One of the two compression settings shown in the settings screen.

features.name: Video dimensions slider
features.description: Scales resolution as a percentage of the original (80% suggested).

features.name: Total size of the selection
features.description: Shows the summed size of the selected videos before compressing.

features.name: Batch compression with per-video progress
features.description: Overall ring with percent, 'video N of M', per-file progress bars, cancel button.
features.reason: Pro feature in the original; free in Sbu.

features.name: Result with before, after, savings
features.description: Done screen with three numbers and the count of saved videos.

features.name: Delete or keep originals
features.description: After compressing, choose to delete originals (destructive) or keep them.
features.reason: Frees space, which is the app's promise.

features.name: Save to library and a dedicated album
features.description: Output goes to the camera roll and to an album named for compressed videos.

features.name: Daily compression limit, ads, Pro subscription
features.description: Free tier limits videos per day and shows ads; Pro (monthly, annual, lifetime) removes them and unlocks batch.
features.reason: Paywall and ads are forbidden in Sbu.

features.name: Third-party ad tracking
features.description: Privacy label declares location, device ID, advertising and diagnostics data used to track.

screens.name: Home / picker
screens.purpose: Start: pick one or more videos.

data_model.storage: No persistent data; output written to the photo library.

paywalled_features: Batch (more than one video at a time)
